articles.title: Lee's approval rating falls to 53%: poll
articles.description: President Lee Jae Myung's approval rating has dipped to the lowest level since his inauguration, a poll showed Thursday. In a National Barometer Survey (NBS) conducted from Monday to Wednesday, the positive assessment of Lee's performance came to 53 percent, down 2 percentage points from the previous poll conducted two weeks earlier.
